# Heart Floating Above Three Level Podium — reference review

- source: `pictographic-primitives/_uncategorized_26/love heart ranking_23d9de33-2d15-4372-8f12-18cd47ea7ba3.svg`
- source UUID: `23d9de33-2d15-4372-8f12-18cd47ea7ba3`
- classification: side_combination
- review: pending_human_review

The stepped podium and detached heart remain distinct symbols. The heart floats above the highest platform as the subject of the ranking, rather than a physical podium feature.

## Visual draft

A large heart floats above a three level podium, centered over its tallest middle platform. Two shorter side platforms extend outward with flat tops and straight vertical edges below.

## 1. Three level podium (solo)

A stepped podium has a tall central platform and shorter side platforms, all with flat tops and straight vertical edges. Exclude the heart.

## 2. Broad heart (sub)

A broad heart has two rounded upper lobes meeting at a central notch and tapering into a lower point. Exclude the podium.
